body.prose:
Under [the rule](https://github.com/Cwejman/the-rule/blob/main/rule.md#3-what-knowledge-is-made-of) a brief is one piece of prose giving one understanding, and a brief with everything beneath it is a holon, so in the store a brief is a holon.

What stands beneath it is ordered, each brief standing on those before it. Links are its free relations, and in the store a link points at a holon's identity, so it survives the holon moving. Some holons are records, read in the order of time rather than by importance, like the author's words kept by day.

*Carried from the rule and its practice; the link by identity the session's, 2026-11-01.*
body.title: The rule's knowledge, held as holons
